note: Group-level sites for press-kit detection. A press office sits at group level, not venue level - Maybourne's media centre is on maybourne.com, not on claridges.co.uk - so checking each venue's homepage misses it every time. Domains here are checked by an actual fetch; anything that fails is recorded as an error rather than left looking valid. Wolseley and MW Eat domains were GUESSED on the first pass and both failed to resolve - looked up properly 2026-08-17. The failure was visible rather than silent, which is the point of recording pressError instead of leaving a bad URL in place.
